subject: Musa acuminata (Cavendish Banana)
hypothesis: Biological Organisms are Legacy Systems running on Liquid Servers.

software.genome: Read-Only Database (No Write Access in clones)

vulnerability_report.root_cause: Monoculture (Zero Code Diversity). All units share identical source code.
vulnerability_report.exploit: Pathogen bypasses firewall (cell wall) and injects malicious logic into the vascular system.
vulnerability_report.patch_status: PATCH FAILED. No mechanism for OTA (Over-The-Air) updates in clonal systems.

cure_candidate.sample_context: Личный живой образец Hawkar, выращиваемый на подоконнике в Украине.

identity.cultivar_identity: Kyiv Dwarf is documented as a recurring Ukrainian retail name; authenticated botanical and genetic identity remains unverified
identity.ukrainian_breeding_origin: claimed or implied by the retail name and seller descriptions; no breeder record or peer-reviewed provenance is attached
identity.genetically_modified: unverified; no documentary or molecular evidence currently attached
identity.note: Местное торговое или домашнее название не является доказательством отдельного культивара, нового вида или ГМО.

commercial_observation_layer.evidence_class: operator-supplied retail descriptions; not an authenticated cultivar register or controlled study
commercial_observation_layer.recurring_name: Банан Київський Карлик / Банан Киевский Карлик
what_this_supports: the commercial name is used repeatedly in the Ukrainian plant market
the plant is marketed as a compact indoor fruiting phenotype
Hawkar's windowsill sample can be tracked against those phenotype claims
what_this_does_not_support: genetic distinction from existing dwarf Cavendish material

cloning_breakthrough_assessment.reason: Bananas are commonly propagated clonally by suckers or tissue culture. Repeated retail availability and a stable dwarf phenotype do not by themselves demonstrate a new cloning technology.
cloning_breakthrough_assessment.interesting_hypothesis: If authenticated plants sold under this name form a stable genetic or epigenetic cluster distinct from reference dwarf Cavendish, the material could represent a locally selected clone or somaclonal line worth characterising.
minimum_evidence: molecular comparison against authenticated dwarf Cavendish references
replicated phenotype measurements across independent plants
archived living material or tissue samples with chain of custody

tr4_claim.current_evidence: no controlled Foc TR4 challenge, genotype certificate, peer-reviewed report, or independent replication

legacy_system_analogy.fork: locally observed dwarf Musa instance with unknown provenance
legacy_system_analogy.patch_hypothesis: the sample may contain genetic or epigenetic variation relevant to disease response
legacy_system_analogy.required_test: identify the build before claiming the vulnerability is patched
legacy_system_analogy.warning: Different appearance or indoor survival is not evidence of TR4 resistance.

verification_pipeline.name: PROVENANCE
actions: preserve seller label, receipt and propagation history
record dated whole-plant, pseudostem and leaf photographs
record whether the plant came from seed, sucker or tissue culture

verification_pipeline.name: IDENTITY
actions: obtain taxonomic assessment from a Musa specialist
use an accredited laboratory for cultivar-oriented molecular fingerprinting
compare against authenticated Cavendish and dwarf-cultivar references

verification_pipeline.name: GM_STATUS
actions: if a specific transgene is claimed, test for that construct in an accredited laboratory
do not infer genetic modification from phenotype alone

verification_pipeline.name: TR4_SCREEN
actions: use only an authorised containment laboratory or quarantine facility
run replicated blinded comparison with authenticated susceptible and resistant controls
measure disease severity, vascular discoloration, survival and pathogen load

biosecurity_boundary.reason: Foc TR4 is a destructive soil-borne quarantine pathogen that can be spread in contaminated plant material, soil, water, footwear and tools.
safe_now: contact an authorised plant pathology laboratory before any pathogen work
do_not: bring suspect infected soil or plants home
share unverified plant material as resistant stock
label the sample Cure before controlled evidence exists

scientific_boundary.metaphor: Compiler, SQL injection, server, OTA and refactoring language is an explanatory analogy.
scientific_boundary.biology: TR4 is Fusarium wilt caused by Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense tropical race 4; it is not literal code execution or SQL injection.
scientific_boundary.diversity_note: Clonal monoculture can amplify shared susceptibility, but resistance must be demonstrated experimentally rather than inferred from clone novelty.
scientific_boundary.evidence_rule: Observation creates a hypothesis; controlled comparison creates evidence.

conclusion.statement: The banana is not a fruit. It is a compiled object.
conclusion.implication: If we can read this code, we can eventually refactor it.
conclusion.legacy_note: Respect the Senior Developer (Nature). Do not push to prod without testing.
conclusion.kyiv_dwarf_note: The Kyiv Dwarf sample is preserved beside Cavendish as a Cure candidate, not declared a Cure.

sources.evidence_gap: No authoritative record confirming a cultivar named Kyiv/Kiev Dwarf, Ukrainian GM origin, or TR4 resistance was located during the 2026-06-19 registry audit.
